question: Has a Fields Medalist ever lectured at AIMS Cameroon?
answer: Yes — 2010 Fields Medalist Cedric Villani visited AIMS-Cameroon three times since it opened, the longest visit being a week in February 2016 giving lectures and discussions.
evidence: AIMS-Cameroon has had three opportunities to welcome Field Medalist and Member of the French Academy of Sciences, Cedric Villani to Cameroon

question: what did villani lecture on at aims cameroon
answer: Lectures included “The Living Art of Mathematics” and “Hundred years of general relativity and gravitational waves.”
evidence: Hundred years of general relativity and gravitational waves

question: did villani visit anywhere else in cameroon besides aims
answer: Yes — he visited the Bimbia Slave Trade Village with the Limbe III Council, and gave a lecture at the University of Douala on his way back to the airport.
evidence: He spent Thursday the 25th February visiting the Bimbia Slave Trade Village
